title: Field Service Schedule for Mobility Equipment — Repair Rates, Response Times and Replacement Values
content:
# Field Service Schedule — Mobility Equipment

The values below set the repair rate, the response times and the replacement values of each Mobility Equipment class.

## Definitions

- **Reasonable useful lifetime** — calendar months, counted from the delivery date, before which coverage does not replace the chair for age.
- **Repair labor rate** — the labor rate per 15-minute unit on a repair of an owned chair (K0739), in US dollars.
- **Repair-versus-replace threshold** — the repair cost, as a percentage of the class's fee-schedule purchase amount, above which the chair is replaced instead of repaired.
- **Fault assessment time** — business days within which a technician assesses a reported fault on an owned chair.
- **Rental repair or swap time** — business days within which a malfunctioning rented chair is repaired or swapped.
- **Loaner during owned-chair repair** — whether a loaner chair is issued while an owned chair is out for repair.
- **Replacement for change in condition** — whether a documented change in medical condition allows replacement before the end of the useful lifetime.
- **Report for loss or theft** — whether replacement for loss or theft before the end of the useful lifetime requires a police, fire or insurance report.

## Schedule

| Class | Useful lifetime (months) | Labor rate per 15-minute unit (USD) | Repair-versus-replace threshold (percent) | Fault assessment (business days) | Rental repair or swap (business days) | Loaner during owned-chair repair | Replacement for change in condition | Report required for loss or theft |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Manual Wheelchair (K0001) | 60 | 23.86 | 100 | 3 | 1 | yes | yes | yes |
| Lightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0003) | 60 | 23.86 | 100 | 3 | 1 | yes | yes | yes |
| High-Strength Lightweight Wheelchair (K0004) | 60 | 23.86 | 100 | 3 | 1 | yes | yes | yes |
| Ultralightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0005) | 60 | 23.86 | 100 | 3 | 2 | yes | yes | yes |
| Group 2 Standard Power Wheelchair (K0823) | 60 | 23.86 | 100 | 2 | 2 | yes | yes | yes |
| Group 3 Complex Rehab Power Wheelchair (K0856) | 60 | 23.86 | 100 | 2 | 3 | yes | yes | yes |

## Reading the schedule

- **What varies by class?** Only the two response times: the fault assessment time (3 business days for the manual classes, 2 for the power classes) and the rental repair or swap time (1 for K0001, K0003 and K0004, 2 for K0005 and K0823, 3 for K0856). Every other value is the same for all six classes.
- **Labor at the schedule rate (hypothetical job).** A repair recorded at 6 units of 15 minutes comes to 6 multiplied by 23.86, that is 143.16 of labor.
- **Threshold at 100 percent.** The threshold is reached when the repair cost would exceed the full fee-schedule purchase amount of the class.
